responsibility: This generator reads match-and-simplify descriptions (such as match.pd) and produces the decision-tree-based simplification code shared by GCC’s GIMPLE and GENERIC folders. It preprocesses the input with libcpp, parses pattern language constructs, captures, predicates, and control flow, lowers them into internal matcher trees, performs validation and normalization, builds decision trees, and finally emits the generated predicate and simplifier implementations that become gimple-match.cc or generic-match.cc.
